movie.title: Love in Slow Motion
movie.overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her best friend gets engaged, chronically single Haya is forced to confront her hidden feelings and realize that true love might have been standing beside her all along.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Haya has always been comfortably single, relying on her tight-knit bond with her best friend Jawad. However, her world is completely upended when Jawad unexpectedly announces his engagement. Forced to navigate a wave of unexpected jealousy and grief, Haya must decide whether to keep her feelings hidden or risk everything to confess her love before it's too late.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Haya has spent years content in her chronically single lifestyle, safe in the comfortable routine of her deep friendship with Jawad. Everything changes in an instant when Jawad announces his engagement, leaving Haya blindsided and emotionally unmoored. As the wedding preparations begin, Haya tries her best to play the supportive best friend, but every milestone only heightens her sense of loss. She slowly comes to the painful realization that her feelings for Jawad run far deeper than friendship. Comedic misadventures and awkward double dates ensue as Haya attempts to move on, only to find herself drawn back to Jawad at every turn. Jawad, too, begins to sense a shift in their dynamic, leading to moments of unspoken tension and growing confusion over his own upcoming marriage. Navigating the delicate balance between loyalty and desire, Haya is pushed to a breaking point as the wedding day approaches. Ultimately, she must find the courage to confront her true emotions and discover if Jawad feels the same way before his future is sealed.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Love in Slow Motion is a heartwarming romantic comedy-drama that explores the delicate transition from platonic friendship to unexpected romance. When Haya's life as a contentedly single woman is disrupted by her best friend Jawad's sudden engagement, she is thrust into a journey of self-discovery and emotional vulnerability. Balancing laugh-out-loud moments of romantic missteps with poignant reflections on timing and devotion, the narrative captures the sweet, agonizing realization that the person you were meant to be with may have been right beside you all along.

story_structure.climax: As the wedding draws near, a crucial moment forces Haya to confront the reality of Jawad's upcoming marriage and make a choice about declaring her true feelings.
story_structure.conflict: Jawad announces his engagement, causing Haya's world to unravel as she confronts unexpected feelings and realizes she may be in love with her best friend.
story_structure.resolution: Haya gains clarity on her emotional journey and finds a new, authentic direction for her life and her relationship with Jawad.
story_structure.introduction: Haya leads a content, chronically-single life anchored by her deep, comfortable friendship with Jawad.
story_structure.risingAction: Haya navigates the emotional awkwardness of wedding preparations while trying to process her hidden feelings and decide whether to risk her friendship by speaking up.
